title: Vulkan: reduction to a scalar output emits no grid (single-threaded, 20x below peak bandwidth)
device: AMD Radeon RX 460 / RADV POLARIS11, Mesa 25.0.7, Vulkan 1.4.305
summary: A reduce whose output has a single element is scheduled with grid=1: 255 of 256 threads are masked off and one thread walks the reduce axis serially.
expected: the grid should be derived from the reduce axis extent, not the output extent; splitting the reduce axis with rfactor would restore parallelism and is bit-exact for max/min
impact_in_a_real_graph: TruFor: 13.4% of whole-graph GPU time (334 ms of 2464 ms) in one kernel
